commits.message:
Add issue closure recommendation workflow (#6423)

## Summary

- Add an experimental weekly and manually targeted agentic workflow that
identifies open issues with recent merged same-repository pull request
references.
- Require semantic scope equivalence and post-merge corroboration before
recommending maintainer review.
- Add a custom safe-output handler that binds recommendations to trusted
collected evidence, revalidates issue and pull request state, and only
adds `Needs-Attention` plus a templated comment.
- Stage all writes outside `microsoft/winget-cli`, preserve idempotency,
and never close issues or remove labels.
- Use repository-compatible recent-window terminology so the workflow
passes spelling validation.

Created with GitHub Copilot assistance.

## Validation

- Compiled the Markdown source with `gh aw compile
issue-closure-recommendation --actionlint`.
- Scheduled staged trial rejected all four recent false-positive
candidates:
https://github.com/denelon/gh-aw-trial/actions/runs/30768085305
- Targeted staged trial validated a high-confidence recommendation for
issue 2129:
https://github.com/denelon/gh-aw-trial/actions/runs/30768328394
